beers.name: Pilsen Lager
beers.description: Our Unleash the Yeast series was an epic experiment into the differences in aroma and flavour provided by switching up your yeast. We brewed up a wort with a light caramel note and some toasty biscuit flavour, and hopped it with Amarillo and Centennial for a citrusy bitterness.

beers.name: Avery Brown Dredge
beers.description: We let it sit out in the open air for 12 hours for perfect flatness and add brown sauce for more brownness...

beers.name: AB:12
beers.description: An Imperial Black Belgian Ale aged in old Invergordon Scotch whisky barrels with mountains of raspberries, tayberries and blackberries in each cask. Decadent but light and dry.
reviews: I lost my pet squirrel to this beer

beers.name: AB:07
beers.description: Whisky cask-aged imperial scotch ale. Beer perfect for when the rain is coming sideways. Liquorice, plum and raisin temper the warming alcohol.
reviews: I like to drink this while watching TV
A beer like no other, best served hot

beers.name: Bramling X
beers.description: Bramling Cross re-invented and re-imagined: a fruity riot of blackberries, pears, and plums with enough British hops to make a point.
reviews: It was smooth and well aged

beers.name: Misspent Youth
beers.description: The brainchild of our small batch brewer, George Woods. A dangerously drinkable milk sugar-infused Scotch Ale.
reviews: Woe is me, how I long for the days of yore
Reminds me of that time I wasted all of my time
It's a flavor that makes you wonder: 'Who is the boss: Angela or Tony?'

beers.name: Arcade Nation
beers.description: Running the knife-edge between an India Pale Ale and a Stout, this Black IPA balances citrus, mango and pine against roasty malt dryness.

beers.name: Movember
beers.description: A deliciously robust, black malted beer with a decadent dark, dry cocoa flavour that provides an enticing backdrop to the Cascade hops.
reviews: Like autumn leaves readying themselves for the winter sun
Beep beep, you're having a beer
